sentences.l2: 午间时分，办公室里的人常常打开手机点外卖，希望在一小时午休内解决吃饭问题。
sentences.l1: At midday, people in the office often open their phones to order takeout, hoping to solve the problem of eating within a one-hour lunch break.

sentences.l2: 看似简单的订单背后，却牵连着骑手紧张而细密的工作节奏。
sentences.l1: Behind a seemingly simple order lies the tense and intricate work rhythm of the delivery rider.

sentences.l2: 平台算法根据距离、天气、路况和商家出餐速度不断调整路线与时限，使骑手必须在有限时间内完成取餐、送达和沟通。
sentences.l1: The platform algorithm constantly adjusts routes and time limits according to distance, weather, road conditions and the speed at which the merchant prepares the food, so that the rider must complete picking up the food, delivering it and communicating within limited time.

sentences.l2: 一旦遇到电梯拥堵、暴雨或交通管制，超时便可能随之而来；而消费者在等待中产生的焦虑，又容易转化为差评。
sentences.l1: Once they run into elevator congestion, a rainstorm or traffic control, being overtime may follow; and the anxiety consumers feel while waiting easily turns into bad reviews.

sentences.l2: 对骑手而言，差评不仅意味着收入受损，也可能影响后续接单机会。
sentences.l1: For riders, a bad review not only means lost income, but may also affect their chances of getting orders afterwards.

sentences.l2: 因此，办公室点餐者若能提前下单、写明送达位置，并在合理时间内给予理解，便能让这份便利少一些压力，多一份善意。
sentences.l1: Therefore, if office workers who order meals can place orders in advance, write down the delivery location, and show understanding within a reasonable time, they can make this convenience carry a little less pressure and a little more kindness.
